verdict.rationale: SigNoz publishes its source in a public GitHub repo described as 'free open-source' (signoz-gh-1), and its docs call it an open-source platform (signoz-probe-2). Community users treat it as OSS. One commenter notes the 'ee/' directory is under a separate license, which makes it open-core rather than fully open. missing for 10: the specific license name (e.g., Apache/MIT) is not evidenced, the enterprise 'ee/' code is not under the open license, and there is no first-party licensing doc.
